ruleLine: the run climbs by rank and IGNORES SUIT / a king ends it / you pay in POINTS, not cards (ace 1, court cards 10 each)
board: Board (a box pays only on its exact card, suit included / unclaimed boxes carry over)
selectLead: The run is stopped -- lead any card
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
hint.lead: the run is stopped, so start low
tutorial.noSuit: The run never looks at suit -- it simply climbs by rank. Coming from Pope Joan you will hunt for the next card of the same suit and miss playable cards.
tutorial.exactCard: Exactly one card claims each box, suit included. The seven of spades does not claim the yellow dwarf; only the seven of diamonds does.
tutorial.carryOver: Chips on a box nobody claims carry into the next deal. The dwarf takes five a deal, so left alone it grows fast.
tutorial.points: When someone goes out you pay the POINTS left in your hand, not the number of cards: ace 1, pip cards face value, and J/Q/K ten each.
